author: Gene Holcombe
text: This happens when the sensor is not properly installed.  The sensor filament is not firmly implanted in your interstitial fluid.  This can be that it’s not installed in the right area of the skin on your arm, you are dehydrated or not applying enough pressure in the applicator when applying it.  I always say to push the applicator hard against your skin, push the applicator hard and hold for 20 seconds
